reason: scopeInputSchema requires setOn and the scope proposal carries that schema whole, so the model writes the date itself; nothing gives it the current date, so the recorded set date (and the reviewOn check) rests on a guessed date.

A span under MIN_QUOTE_WORDS takes the misquote branch even when the page carries it, so the note falsely says the span is not on the page. The verdict is unaffected; only the note's wording is false.
proseBlocks merges list blocks across a blank line, so a restarted list renders as one list (as CommonMark does). Tests do not cover it. The trigger is uncommon and the impact cosmetic.

Company names in the switcher and nav, and the conversation context line, carry no data-record, so the guard would flag a name containing a listed word. Unmarked text is still scanned, so the 'misses' half is wrong. The check is a test/audit tool with no runtime effect.

The user's bubble is added before the POST; on failure the wait line reads 'Ed could not answer this', so the unsent message looks sent and the failure reads as Ed's. The failure is still said and the text stays visible, so impact is low.

Intake saves the plan as a draft and leaves config.domainPlan unchanged; the setup and profile pages still render the old plan with a Start research form the server now refuses with 409. The draft is shown only on the Research page.
Notes are set to 'sent' before the try; a throw in recordInsightReview or createBatchRun leaves them 'sent', and the queue reads only pending/failed, so they are never retried or marked failed.
move_enquiry and verify_claim start rerunTogether model calls with no provider permission check, while the other batch paths check first.
recordAnalysisRerun closes the flag when the run starts; if the run later fails the flag no longer shows and cannot be chosen again. The run's failure is visible as a run.

actionRevisions returns the superseding Action's first status note unfiltered, but the only writers on supersede are system phrases and no caller passes a person's note, so no note a strategist wrote reaches a client.

The Documents page lists every current source without an audience filter, but the code has no strategist-only class of source ('internal' means private to the company, not hidden from its client), and clients can already read the same list through the documents API.
The web process installs no signal handler and close() never drains, so a briefing in flight when it stops is dropped without a log line; the CLI and worker do drain.
For depth 'deep' the route calls researchThenAnswer whatever the corpus, which always runs web research, so 'Your documents' + Deep runs and pays for web research.
Ed's own chat renders no composer, but THREAD_JS dereferences the form without a null check and throws; the page's scripts are one <script>, so the artefact panel script also stops.
The claim sets the reading note; if the job dies mid-read, every later job skips it and nothing clears a stale claim, so the document is never read and shows 'Ed is reading it' for ever.
